title: Character Consistency
description: Cloud video-gen character consistency contract: per-character style anchors and reference frames used to bind video generation across many scenes so one character keeps the same look. Complements (does not replace) the local-rig `character_design` artifact used by the character-animation pipeline.

style.description: Shared visual language applied to every character reference frame

id.description: Stable character id used in scene plans and asset linkage

appearance.description: Concrete, identity-anchoring physical description (age, face, build, clothing, hair, distinguishing marks) — written so an image model reproduces the SAME character every time.

reference_prompt.description: The exact image-generation prompt used to render this character's anchor reference frame(s). Must embed style + appearance verbatim for reproducibility.

reference_frames.description: Generated anchor frames for this character (filled by character_consistency_builder)

binding_hints.description: How to bind this character into downstream video generation

reference_image_paths.description: Paths passed as reference_image_paths to video generation tools (seedance_video, veo_video, etc.)

preferred_providers.description: Video-gen providers with strong character consistency for this character (e.g. higgsfield, seedance, veo)

first_frame_path.description: Optional canonical first-frame to anchor scene openings
